voices.note: the mishnah at 16a.7-8: laborers atop the tree; the groom's exemption and Rabban Gamliel's maaseh
Rabban Gamliel, in the mishnah's maaseh
Rabban Gamliel's students, who challenge him in the mishnah's maaseh
Rav Mari son of Shmuel's daughter; raises the contradiction and reports Rav Sheshet
the baraita of the ורמינהי at 16a.10 (הקורא את שמע צריך שיכוין את לבו)
his proviso (16a.11, via Rav Mari) and his assignment of the baraitot (16a.15)
the והתניא at 16a.12, reporting Beit Hillel
the תנו רבנן at 16a.14 (they pray the Eighteen)

props.gloss_en: laborers recite [the Shema] atop the tree and atop the course of stones
which they are not permitted to do for prayer
a groom is exempt from reciting the Shema from the first night until Saturday night, if he has not performed the act
Rabban Gamliel married a woman and recited [the Shema] on the first night
Rabban Gamliel: I will not listen to you to cast off from myself the kingdom of heaven even for one hour
and [laborers] pray atop the olive tree and atop the fig tree
and for all other trees they climb down and pray
and the householder, either way, climbs down and prays
because his mind is not settled upon him
one who recites the Shema must direct his heart
Rav Sheshet: and [that is] when they stop their work and recite
Beit Hillel say: they engage in their work and recite
no difficulty: this [stopping work] is in the first paragraph
that [working while reciting] is in the second paragraph
laborers working for a householder recite the Shema and bless before and after it
and they eat their bread and bless before and after it
and they pray the prayer of Eighteen
but they do not go down before the ark
and they do not lift their hands [in the priestly blessing]
[laborers pray] an abridgement of the Eighteen
Rav Sheshet: this [baraita, the full Eighteen] is Rabban Gamliel
Rav Sheshet: that [baraita, the abridged Eighteen] is R' Yehoshua
rather, both this and that are Rabban Gamliel
and no difficulty: here [the abridged Eighteen] when they work for their wage
there [the full Eighteen] when they work for their meal
and they eat their bread and do not bless before it
but they bless two after it: the first blessing in its standard form; the second opens with the blessing of the land, and they include 'who builds Jerusalem' in the blessing of the land
in what case is this said? of those who work for their wage
but those who work for their meal, or whose householder reclines with them, bless in its standard form

schemas.gloss_en: שנאמר שמע ישראל, ולהלן הוא אומר הסכת ושמע ישראל -- מה להלן בהסכת אף כאן בהסכת: the Shema, like 'pay attention and hear, Israel', requires attention

supports.gloss_en: והתניא: הפועלים... במה דברים אמורים בעושין בשכרן, אבל עושין בסעודתן... מברכין כתיקונה -- a baraita already treats wage-laborers and meal-laborers differently

objections.gloss_en: אמרו לו תלמידיו: לימדתנו רבינו שחתן פטור מקריאת שמע? -- you taught us a groom is exempt; why did you recite?

answered_by.gloss_en: איני שומע לכם לבטל הימני מלכות שמים אפילו שעה אחת (= p_lo_levatel_malchut)

objections.gloss_en: רמי ליה רב מרי לרבא: תנן האומנין קורין בראש האילן -- אלמא לא בעי כוונה; ורמינהי: הקורא את שמע צריך שיכוין את לבו -- the mishnah implies no intent is needed, the baraita requires it

answered_by.gloss_en: הכי אמר רב ששת: והוא שבטלין ממלאכתן וקורין -- the mishnah speaks of laborers who stop their work to recite (= p_betelin; reported by Rav Mari after Rava was silent)

objections.gloss_en: והתניא: בית הלל אומרים עוסקים במלאכתן וקורין -- Beit Hillel have them reciting while working

answered_by.gloss_en: לא קשיא: הא בפרק ראשון, הא בפרק שני -- stopping work is for the first paragraph, working on is for the second (= p_betelin_perek_rishon, p_oskim_perek_sheni)

objections.gloss_en: והתניא: מעין שמונה עשרה -- another baraita has laborers praying an abridged Eighteen

answered_by.gloss_en: אמר רב ששת: לא קשיא, הא רבן גמליאל, הא רבי יהושע (= p_rs_shmone_esre_rg, p_rs_meein_ry) -- SUPERSEDED: its R' Yehoshua half falls at 16a.16 and the stam answers again with אלא
אלא אידי ואידי רבן גמליאל, ולא קשיא: כאן בעושין בשכרן, כאן בעושין בסעודתן (= p_meein_rg, p_meein_bischaran, p_shmone_esre_bisudatan)

objections.gloss_en: אי רבי יהושע, מאי איריא פועלים? אפילו כל אדם נמי! -- if the abridged Eighteen were R' Yehoshua's, the baraita would not have specified laborers
